headlines.description: President Trump called for an investigation into the government's economic statistics on Thursday, alleging without evidence that growth figures released before the midterm elections were deliberately understated. Why it matters: Revisions to GDP are routine and reflect more complete information that becomes available after the initial estimates are published.

headlines.name: ABC
headlines.headline: Judge blocks FCC from early license review for ABC, which network says has had a chilling effect
headlines.description: A federal judge on Wednesday blocked the Federal Communications Commission from conducting an early review of ABC’s broadcast licenses, agreeing with the network that the Trump administration was chilling the network's free speech rights.
